paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: (LEFT) The trend of Pass@1 rate on Visual Navigation as the number of reasoning steps increases. (right) The relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse) and tree width for rollout search. We observe that LVLMs significantly benefit from longer reasoning chains, although the effect plateaus rapidly beyond a certain threshold of reasoning steps. The relationship between performance and tree width exhibits a more complex pattern, demonstrating an inverted U-shaped trend with both GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between tree width and Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse). The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35. A blue line with circular markers shows the data for "GPT-4o," starting at 26.7% at x=1, increasing to 27.8% at x=3, peaking at 34.4% at x=5, and then decreasing to 31.1% at x=7. An orange line with star markers shows the data for "Claude-3.5-Sonnet," starting at 24.4% at x=1, decreasing to 20.0% at x=7.
